title: European Stroke Organisation (ESO) guidelines on management of transient ischaemic attack
shortTitle: European Stroke Organisation (ESO) guidelines on management of transient

recommendations.classNote: Scope summary quoted from the publication abstract; the full graded recommendations are in the linked source.
recommendations.text: The aim of the present European Stroke Organisation Transient Ischaemic Attack (TIA) management guideline document is to provide clinically useful evidence-based recommendations on approaches to triage, investigation and secondary prevention, particularly in the acute phase following TIA. The guidelines were prepared following the Standard Operational Procedure for a European Stroke Organisation guideline document and according to GRADE methodology.
